doc.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Bangkok, the king and favorite places
summary: He loved Bangkok, which he visited with Duke; they met the king; also Hong Kong and Chicago, and he wanted to leave New York.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: If you were to be able to make a tour of the world, and make like a couple of different stops to play in, have you been to places in the world that you’d love to go back to?
Yeah, a place in — I went there about three times with Duke — Bangkok.
Now wasn’t Bangkok where the king, or whoever they called him, was a jazz fan?

Yeah I like Bangkok, I like Hong Kong. In the States I like Chicago. But after I’ve been in New York City for thirty years, I don’t want anything in the City. Thirty years in New York, I said I want to be out where I can hear the birds sing.
